entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The Palace is starting to waver...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Dammit, why is this[n]happening to me!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's quite astonishing how foolish[n]Kaneshiro is.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He made it perfectly clear—he's hiding[n]his Treasure in there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't believe I fell for his trap before...[n]It makes me angry just thinking about it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Channel that energy into your revenge.[n]Take that which is important to him.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If it's in a vault, it's gotta be valuable!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This Treasure's totally gonna be worth[n]stealin'!
